class.name: RailVehiclePantographs
class.brief_description: The pantographs of a rail vehicle: their geometry and how far they are raised.
class.description: As many pantographs as the vehicle's data gives, each built as its [RailVehiclePantograph] of [member pantographs] says. [RailVehicleServer] steps them under the wire it finds over each one ([method pantograph_step]); whatever draws the vehicle poses their arms from [method get_pantograph_lower_raise] and [method get_pantograph_upper_raise]. Changing the configuration rebuilds them: a pantograph that gets its geometry only now starts lowered, and one raised already keeps its slider's height as far as the new arms allow it - no lower than at rest, no higher than they reach ([method pantograph_fit]); [RailVehicleServer] holds it under the wire over it.

method.name: get_pantograph_control
method.description: Returns the channel of the power source pantograph [param index] is raised by.

method.name: get_pantograph_count
method.description: Returns how many pantographs the vehicle has.

method.name: get_pantograph_has_geometry
method.description: Returns whether pantograph [param index] has its geometry ([member RailVehiclePantograph.has_geometry]).

method.name: get_pantograph_height
method.description: Returns the height of the slider of pantograph [param index] over its position [lb]m[rb].

method.name: get_pantograph_lower_raise
method.description: Returns how far the lower arm of pantograph [param index] is raised over lowered [lb]rad[rb].

method.name: get_pantograph_position
method.description: Returns where pantograph [param index] stands in the vehicle's own space; zero for one without geometry.

method.name: get_pantograph_reaches_wire
method.description: Returns whether the slider of pantograph [param index] reaches the wire; one without geometry always does.

method.name: get_pantograph_upper_raise
method.description: Returns how far the upper arm of pantograph [param index] is raised over lowered [lb]rad[rb].

method.name: pantograph_fit
method.description: Keeps the slider's height of pantograph [param index] as far as its arms allow it: no lower than at rest, no higher than they reach nor than [param max_height] [lb]m[rb] - the wire over it.

method.name: pantograph_step
method.description: One step of the arms of pantograph [param index], [param gap] [lb]m[rb] below the wire: towards it at [param speed_factor] while [param active], down while lowered, over [param delta] [lb]s[rb]. A pantograph without geometry is not moved.

members.member: One [RailVehiclePantograph] a pantograph of the vehicle; empty for a vehicle without any. Applied with [method VehicleComponent.apply_config].
